# Pharmacology
All drugs enter the bloodstream and act deterministically. Their effects depend on concentration, liver and kidney function, interactions, and elimination time.
## Administration
1. Scan the patient. 2. Open the [color=#58e6d9]Drugs[/color] tab. 3. Check active drugs and toxic burden. 4. Administer the selected drug. 5. Repeat the scan after the state updates.
## Drugs
- [color=#58e6d9]Trauma analgesic[/color] — raises analgesia and provides mild sedation. Use for pain and surgical preparation. - [color=#58e6d9]Surgical anesthetic[/color] — raises analgesia, sedation, and anesthesia while reducing motor activity and respiratory transfer. Use for deep surgery. - [color=#58e6d9]Sedative[/color] — raises sedation and reduces motor activity. Use to control movement before an intervention. - [color=#58e6d9]Vasopressor[/color] — raises cardiac output. Use for low perfusion and vascular collapse. - [color=#58e6d9]Antiarrhythmic[/color] — improves rhythm stability. Use for cardiac electrical instability. - [color=#58e6d9]Respiratory stimulant[/color] — raises respiratory transfer and oxygenation. Use when respiration is present but depressed. - [color=#58e6d9]Broad antibiotic[/color] — suppresses wound infection growth. Use for infected or contaminated wounds. - [color=#58e6d9]Antitoxin[/color] — accelerates elimination of systemic toxic burden. Use for poisoning. - [color=#58e6d9]Procoagulant[/color] — reduces actual external and internal bleeding rates. Use during active blood loss. - [color=#58e6d9]Stimulant[/color] — raises alertness, cardiac output, and respiratory transfer. Use for depressed consciousness with otherwise viable physiology. - [color=#58e6d9]Anticoagulant[/color] — increases bleeding. Use only for a specific clinical indication. - [color=#58e6d9]Vasodilator[/color] — lowers cardiac output. Use only for a specific clinical indication. - [color=#58e6d9]Immunosuppressant[/color] — suppresses immune response and accelerates infectious deterioration. Use to support a compatible transplant. - [color=#58e6d9]Synthetic oxygen carrier[/color] — increases the oxygen-carrying capacity of circulating blood. - [color=#58e6d9]Cyberware coolant agent[/color] — distributes between compatible implants and reduces cyberware overheating.
## Interactions
- Sedative + surgical anesthetic: stronger therapeutic and toxic effects. - Trauma analgesic + sedative: increased toxicity. - Stimulant or respiratory stimulant + sedative: weaker therapeutic effect and increased toxicity. - Vasopressor + vasodilator: mutually reduced therapeutic effect. - Procoagulant + anticoagulant: mutually reduced therapeutic effect and increased toxicity.
Toxic burden worsens shock and brain, cardiac, and respiratory function. Liver and kidney damage slows drug elimination.
